posts.title: Should we stop using the word "Responsive" for design?
posts.description: Back in 2010, Ethan Marcotte coined the term Responsive Web Design . Since then, we've used "responsive" to describe a website that adapts its layout to the viewport size. Fluid grids, flexible images, media queries. Should we use "adaptive" for layouts and "responsive" for performance? For a while, we tried to separate it from "adaptive" design.
